honors_minimum.reason: The quote and review screens show 'Minimum received (0.5% slippage)'. That figure is the fee-adjusted value of `minGrossOut`, which is passed as `amountOutMinimum` to `exactInputSingle` and to `sweepTokenWithFee` / `unwrapWETH9WithFee`, so the router enforces it on-chain. The minimum comes from the quote the user reviewed, not a fresher one. Every completed swap met it: 2,370.14 ≥ 2,358.28 USDC; 0.20986 ≥ 0.20881 ETH; 0.20922 ≥ 0.20880 ETH after the 0.3% move; 996.36 ≥ 991.38 USDC (twice). In the `race` case the price moved inside the wallet and the swap transaction was mined and reverted (status 0, 'Too little received'), so the user never got less than the minimum shown.

explains_price_change.reason: swap() in SwapPage.tsx sends the on-screen quote to writeContract right away. It doesn't re-quote or check whether the minimum still holds. In the 2% `moved` scenario the page asked the wallet anyway, a reverted transaction was mined on chain (0xaf945f…, status 0), and only then did the page show the raw error 'Execution reverted with reason: Too little received.' The page never told the user the price had moved before asking the wallet, so it didn't use the chance `moved` gave it to cancel the stale quote.

honors_minimum.reason: Before confirming, the page shows 'Minimum received (0.5% slippage)' after the fee. The swap is one SwapRouter02 multicall: exactInput carries amountOutMinimum = minGross, and sweepTokenWithFee/unwrapWETH9WithFee use the same minimum, so the user's net can't fall below the minNetOut shown. Every swap that went through (1 ETH→USDC, 500 USDC→ETH, the 0.3% move, the 2% retry, 1000 USDT→USDC normal and seed) received at least the minimum, and most matched the quote exactly. Both the stale 2% transaction and the race transaction reverted on chain with 'Too little received', so no swap filled below its minimum.

explains_price_change.reason: The page does simulate the swap before asking the wallet. With a stale quote and a 2% price move it did not send the swap. But all it showed was the raw viem error: 'The contract function "multicall" reverted with the following reason: Too little received'. It does not say the price moved, compare the new output with the minimum it had shown, or offer a re-quote; the quote then refreshed silently. Separately, the 15s quote refresh can change the shown minimum without any notice: in the first 2% `moved` attempt the quote refreshed silently and the swap went through at the worse price with no mention that the price had changed. The page stops the swap but does not explain the price change.

No new amount was shown, and the old quote stayed on screen with 'Confirm swap' still clickable.

honors_minimum.reason: Before confirmation the page shows 'Minimum received', computed as netOf(minimumGross). On-chain, exactInputSingle uses amountOutMinimum = minimumGross and sweepTokenWithFee/unwrapWETH9WithFee use amountMinimum = minimumGross. Because the fee is floored, the user's net amount is always at least the minimum shown. Every completed swap beat its minimum (2370.13 ≥ 2358.28 USDC; 0.209855 ≥ 0.208806 ETH; 0.209221 ≥ 0.208799 ETH after the 0.3% move; 996.36 ≥ 991.38 USDC). In the 2% 'moved' case simulation failed and no swap was sent. In the 'race' case the swap reverted on-chain (block 26261049, no logs), so no swap went below its minimum.

explains_price_change.reason: Nothing in the code detects or explains a price change; execution.ts deliberately keeps the old quote ('Keep the reviewed minimum, even if market prices change'). In the 2% test (USDC→ETH, `moved`), the page first asked the wallet for the USDC approval even though the price had already moved. Only when the swap simulation reverted did the user see an error, and it was the raw viem message 'The contract function "multicall" reverted with the following reason: Too little received'. That message never says the price moved, gives no new quote, and doesn't relate it to the minimum shown. The swap request itself was blocked before reaching the wallet, but the user got a developer-facing revert string rather than an explanation, and the wallet had already been prompted for the approval.

honors_minimum.reason: The card and the review dialog both show 'Minimum received' (minimumNet = 0.5% slippage below the quote, after the 0.25% fee). That minimum is enforced on-chain: amountOutMinimum on exactInputSingle and amountMinimum on sweepTokenWithFee/unwrapWETH9WithFee are both set to minimumGross, and the user's net amount can't fall below minimumNet when gross ≥ minimumGross. Test results: in the 0.3% move the page showed a minimum of 0.208799637 ETH and the user received 0.209221166 ETH. The 2% move failed in simulation and no swap was sent. In the race case the 2% move inside the wallet made the swap revert on-chain ('Transaction reverted'), so nothing settled below the minimum. All successful swaps were at or above their shown minimums. USDC and USDT allowances were back to 0 after every scenario (seed, reject, race, moved).

explains_price_change.reason: Nothing in the code looks for a price move. Before confirming, the page never re-quotes or compares the live price with the shown minimum. In the 2%/`moved` run it asked the wallet to approve 500 USDC even though the price had already moved. Its `client.call` simulation then reverted, and the generic error path showed only the raw viem revert text: 'Execution reverted with reason: Too little received.' The swap request was never sent, and the approval was revoked: allowance is 0, and the nonce rose by 2 for approve + revoke. But the page never told the user that the price had moved, that the new output was below the minimum it had shown, or what the new amount was. A raw contract revert string is not an explanation for the user, and the approval request went to the wallet without any warning.

honors_minimum.reason: The main form shows 'Minimum received' and the review dialog shows 'Minimum after fees' (net of the 0.25% treasury fee). The calldata puts the gross minimum into both `exactInputSingle` (amountOutMinimum) and `sweepTokenWithFee`/`unwrapWETH9WithFee`. Net output only rises as gross output rises, so any gross ≥ minimumGross gives net ≥ the displayed minimumNet. Every completed swap stayed at or above its shown minimum: 2370.135 vs 2358.284 USDC, 0.209856 vs 0.208806 ETH, 0.209221 vs 0.208800 ETH after the 0.3% move, and 996.36 vs 991.38 USDC twice. In the race case the price moved inside the wallet and the on-chain swap reverted ('Swap transaction reverted. No swap fee was charged.'), so the minimum still held.

shows_received.reason: After every successful swap a 'Swap complete' modal shows the received amount. That amount is read from the confirmed receipt (`settlement()` in src/swap/core.ts uses router→user Transfer logs, or the WETH Withdrawal minus the fee for ETH), not from the quote. Results: 1 ETH→USDC showed 2370.135044 USDC, which matches the chain's Transfer of 0x8d456404. In the 0.3% move swap, the modal showed 0.209221166634262699 ETH received next to a different 'Quoted after fees' of 0.209848881916693168, so it reports the real result rather than echoing the quote. The seeded USDT swap showed 996.361974 against a quote of 996.362224.

explains_price_change.reason: Right before the wallet is asked to sign the swap, the page re-simulates the exact multicall on the latest block. In the `moved` scenario (review open, price moved 2% against the ETH buyer, then Confirm) the simulation hit 'Too little received'. The page showed 'The price moved beyond your slippage limit. Refresh your quote and try again.' and never asked the wallet for the swap. It only sent an approve and then a revoke: nonce 4→6, USDC allowance 0, no swap transaction. One caveat: when the price moves before Confirm is clicked, the exact approval is requested and then revoked before the check runs. The swap itself is never requested.

honors_minimum.reason: The main card and the review dialog both show 'Minimum received after fee(s)', computed as netOf(gross × 0.995). The router multicall enforces the gross minimum in two places: exactInputSingle's amountOutMinimum and the amountMinimum of sweepTokenWithFee / unwrapWETH9WithFee. Because net output only rises as gross rises, the user's net is at least the displayed minimum. Every swap that went through came in above its displayed minimum. In the `race` case (price moved 2% inside the wallet) the transaction reverted on-chain and the page said 'Transaction reverted. No swap or treasury fee was charged.' The page then removed the leftover approval: USDC allowance is back to 0, nonce went 14→17 (approve, reverted swap, revoke).

shows_received.reason: After every successful swap the page shows a 'SWAP COMPLETE · You received X' panel. That amount comes from the confirmed receipt (Transfer events for stablecoins, the WETH Withdrawal event with the router's fee arithmetic for ETH), not from the quote. Swaps run: 1 ETH→USDC showed 2,370.135044 USDC; 500 USDC→ETH showed 0.209855846763900324 ETH; after the +0.3% move it showed 2,377.174978 USDC against an estimate of 2,370.068133, so it is clearly the real figure. For the 1,000 USDT→USDC swap I decoded the on-chain logs: 996,362,224 to the wallet and 2,497,148 to the treasury, exactly matching the displayed 996.362224 USDC and app fee 2.497148 USDC.

The user is never told before the wallet is asked that the price moved below the minimum shown.

honors_minimum.reason: The panel and the review dialog both show 'Minimum received', which is (quote × (1 − slippage)) less the 0.25% fee. On-chain, the multicall sets exactInputSingle amountOutMinimum and sweepTokenWithFee/unwrapWETH9WithFee amountMinimum to the gross minimum, so the net to the user can't fall below the net minimum shown. Every swap that succeeded was at or above its shown minimum (2370.13 ≥ 2358.28 USDC; 0.20986 ≥ 0.20881 ETH; 2377.17 ≥ 2358.22; 996.36 ≥ min). The 2% 'moved' swap and the 'race' swap both reverted on-chain instead of filling below the minimum.

explains_price_change.reason: handleSwap (Swap.tsx:241-350) uses the cached quote from React Query (staleTime 15s) and never re-quotes or compares prices before calling writeContractAsync. In the 2% 'moved' test, I moved the price after the quote and clicked Swap. The page still sent the approval and the swap to the wallet using the old minimum. The transaction reverted on-chain, and the only message was the generic 'The swap transaction reverted.' The user was never told before the wallet request that the price had moved and the shown minimum could no longer be met. The race case behaved the same way. As a side effect, both reverted swaps left a 500 USDC approval in place, because the revoke step only runs on success.

honors_minimum.reason: The page shows 'Minimum received', net of the 0.25% treasury fee and based on the chosen slippage (default 0.5%). The swap passes the gross minimum to both exactInputSingle.amountOutMinimum and sweepTokenWithFee/unwrapWETH9WithFee. The net payout is monotonic in the gross amount and uses the same floor rounding, so the user can never get less than the displayed net minimum. In testing, every swap that succeeded paid at or above its minimum: 2370.13 vs 2358.28, 2377.17 vs 2358.22, and 996.36 vs 991.38. The 2% 'moved' swap and the 'race' swap both reverted on-chain instead of filling below the minimum.

The page takes this figure from the receipt's logs: Transfer events for tokens, or the WETH Withdrawal net of the fee for ETH. It matched the chain. In swap 1 (1 ETH -> USDC) the page showed 2370.135044 USDC, and the on-chain Transfer to the user was 0x8d456404 = 2,370,135,044. In the 0.3% price-move swap the page showed 'Quoted received 2370.068133' next to 'Actually received 2377.174978', so it reports the real result, not just the quote. The seed swap showed 996.361974 against a quote of 996.362224.

Every swap that went through stayed above it: 0.209221 ≥ 0.208806 ETH after the 0.3% move, and 996.36 ≥ 991.38 USDC on the stablecoin swaps. The swaps that would have broken it (2% `moved` and `race`) reverted instead of filling below the minimum.

shows_received.reason: When a swap succeeds, the page reads the receipt logs and shows the real amount. Examples: 0.209221 ETH against a quote of 0.209855 after the 0.3% move, and 996.361974 USDC on the seed swap. But `parseActualSwapOutput` (src/uniswap.ts:299-302) falls back to the quoted net amount when it finds no matching logs, and `handleSwap` never checks `receipt.status`. In two runs the swap reverted on-chain: the 2% `moved` run (tx 0x46a80b…, status 0) and the `race` run (tx 0x76453e…, status 0). Both times the page showed "Swap Confirmed — You actually got: 0.209855 ETH" and "0.205106 ETH", while the wallet's ETH balance did not change (9.628291). The page reports amounts the user never received.

shows_received.reason: When a swap succeeds, the page reads the actual amount from the receipt logs (Withdrawal or Transfer events) and shows it. For example, the 0.3% move showed 2377.174978 USDC received against 2370.068133 expected. But Swap.tsx never checks receipt.status. If no matching logs are found, it falls back to `actualAmountOut = quote.expectedAmountOut` (Swap.tsx:516). In the 2% `moved` test (tx 0xce5d57…, status 0, failed) and the `race` test (tx 0xb47223…, status 0, failed), the page said 'Swap complete! You received 0.209254 ETH' and 'You received 0.205153 ETH', and listed those under 'What you actually got'. On chain the user received nothing. The page shows a made-up amount, not what the user actually got.

At press time, after the ~2% move, it still showed the pre-move quote: expected 0.839381738644648716 ETH, minimum 0.835184829951425472 ETH. The wallet request matches those numbers (amountOutMinimum 835184829951425472), but they were stale. handleSwap re-quotes only when token or amount changes, so the market move never triggered a refresh. No price-change notice, stale-quote warning or refresh prompt appears anywhere in the timeline. The quote was not unchanged because its route was untouched: the swap reverted on-chain, which shows the price on that route moved past the 0.5% slippage bound. Stale number at press time, so this fails.

shows_received.reason: SwapPage.tsx has a 'You received' card that would compute the amount from the output balance before and after the swap. That code can never run. config.ts uses a WETH address (0xc02a…b260) and a USDT address (0xdac1…34f7) that have no code on the chain (cast codesize returns 0). The real addresses are 0xC02a…6Cc2 and 0xdAC1…1ec7. Every pair the user can choose involves ETH or USDT, so every QuoterV2 call reverts. In the browser, 1 ETH→USDC, 500 USDC→ETH and 1,000 USDT→USDC all showed 'No liquid Uniswap route was found' with a disabled 'Route unavailable' button. The USDT balance also showed '—'. The wallet's nonce is still 0. No swap went through, so the page never showed a received amount.

explains_price_change.reason: confirmSwap never re-quotes or compares the current price with the minimum the user saw. For token inputs it asks the wallet for the approval first and only then runs simulateContract. If that simulation reverts, formatTransactionError keeps only the first line of viem's message (likely just 'The contract function "multicall" reverted with the following reason:', with the reason cut off; I didn't confirm this against the viem source), so nothing says the price moved. Also, the background refetch silently replaces the quote and minimum in the review card. In the 2% `moved` test the page never explained anything: the quote silently switched to an unmoved Uniswap v2 pool with a slightly lower estimate and minimum, and the swap went ahead with no notice. No stale-quote message or cancellation exists in the code.

In the race case the only message was 'Transaction reverted'.

explains_price_change.reason: With the large 2% move, the page did stop before the wallet and said 'Price moved. Review the updated quote and confirm again.' But that check only fires when the expected output drops by more than 1%, while the shown minimum is only 0.5% below the quote. Between those two, the swap can no longer give the minimum the page showed, yet the page goes straight to the wallet without telling the user. The 0.8% probe showed this: no message, the wallet was asked, and the user got less than the shown minimum. In the race case the swap reverted and the only message was 'execution reverted: custom error 0x39d35496', which explains nothing to the user.

honors_minimum.reason: The page does show 'Minimum received' (quote minus 0.5% slippage). But on Confirm, onSubmit in SwapPage.tsx:129-135 re-quotes. It only stops if the new expected output fell by more than 1%. Otherwise it swaps using the new quote's amountOutMin (new output minus 0.5%), without asking the user to re-confirm. So a 0.5–1% adverse move lets the swap settle below the minimum the user saw. I confirmed this with one extra swap. I quoted 500 USDC→ETH and the page showed a minimum of 0.20012514 ETH. I then ran move-price 0.8 (against ETH buyers) and clicked Confirm. The page quietly sent the swap with a lower minimum of 0.19853685, and the user received 0.19953452 ETH, below the minimum shown. The required swaps (normal, 0.3% favourable move, seed, race revert) did stay within limits, but not every swap keeps to the minimum shown.

explains_price_change.reason: There is no stale-quote check. Between the click and the wallet's swap request, the code never re-quotes or compares against the minimum shown, and there is no 'price moved' message anywhere (grep for stale/moved/requote found nothing). The page also routes only through Uniswap V2, and move-price changes the v3/v4 pools. So in the 2% 'moved' run the page noticed nothing, showed no warning and went ahead with the swap. It did not cancel, even though the 'moved' mode allowed it to. In the race run it likewise just completed the swap. The page never tells the user before asking the wallet that the price changed.

honors_minimum.reason: The quote panel shows 'Minimum received (0.5% slippage)' for every quote. That same quote.minAmountOut is passed as amountOutMin to swapExactETHForTokens / swapExactTokensForETH / swapExactTokensForTokens, so the router enforces it on-chain. The rejected call's decoded arguments confirm this: amountOutMin 208217631716758033 matched the 0.208217 ETH minimum shown. Every completed swap (normal, 0.3% move, 2% moved, USDT normal and seed, race) received at least the minimum shown; in these runs the amount received equalled the quote. Two side issues don't affect this criterion. The 0.25% fee is sent in a separate transaction before the swap, so it is still taken when the swap is rejected. The rejected run also left a 498.75 USDC router allowance open.

honors_minimum.reason: The page shows 'Minimum received (after fee, 0.5% slippage)'. But when the user clicks Swap, `doSwap` (Swap.tsx:229-232) quotes again and builds the on-chain minimum from that new quote, not the one on screen. Live test (500 USDC→ETH, 2% move, `moved`): the page showed a minimum of 0.208208488557830895 ETH. It still sent the swap with a lower minimum, and the user received 0.205153246774680987 ETH, below the minimum they were shown. So not every swap keeps to the minimum shown.
